title: Gate One plugin trust store
description: Local allow-list for signed plugins. Provision it out-of-band (signed lock file, package manager, embedded key); it is never fetched from a plugin. Paths are supplied with usage.trustStore.

keys.description: Signing keys: key id -> raw Ed25519 public key, base64 (standard or raw URL encoding).

allowedNames.description: Allowed plugin names. Exact names or glob patterns interpreted with path.Match (for example com.cladone.*).

allowedDependencies.description: Allowed dependency digests: name -> sha256 digest.

revokedDigests.description: Artefact digests refused even with a valid signature.

allowAuth.description: Allow manifests with kind=auth (high-trust modules). Default false.

coreVersion.description: Host API version, for example 1.5.0. Compared with the manifest hostAPI constraint.
